author: IanODowd
quote:
I can truly count on 1 hand the amount of games in my life that have impacted me deeply. Shenmue is one of them.
For that reason I and many other campaigned for years to just get closure on story we have all deeply invested our hearts into. The fact this game got made is amazing enough but what is truly jaw dropping is that after nearly 20 years of waiting Shenmue 3 honestly lives up to that wait. The feel of Shenmue is here in spades.
I'm enjoying every second I play and I encourage any and all who hasn't played a shenmue game to do so. It will grip u like no other.


Thank Yu.
